## PDF page 35

[Open source PDF](../../../../sources/pdf/GTO/Poker-Math-Preflop-Workbook.pdf#page=35)

```text
                   PREFLOP CHOICES


Here you will be presented with a preflop situation and three possible ranges
you could use. Start by jotting down the %-form for each of the three ranges.
Then, read the prompt and choose which of the three ranges you would use
given the available information.




Finally, write one or two sentences explaining why you chose that range
instead of the others.

GLGL.



                                   PA G E 3 5
```
